description: CDPH-Wastewater Surveillance Data, California is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Public Health. The California Department of Public Health (CDPH) is coordinating with wastewater utilities, local health departments, academic researchers, and laboratories in California on wastewater surveillance for infectious disease pathogens of interest to public health (such as SARS-CoV-2, the virus causing COVID-19, influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), mpox, and norovirus). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Public Health. Its tags are RSV, SuWers, california department of public health, coronavirus, covid. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
